question: What glory is attributed to the sādhaka family and Rāma-Lakṣmī?
premises: adbhutāḥ aprameyavaibhavāḥ names wonderful immeasurable glories
inference: The sādhaka family and Rāma-Lakṣmī possess wonderful immeasurable glories.
plain_english: The sādhaka family; Rāma-Lakṣmī; wonderful, of immeasurable glory.
